record.title: Rotwood
record.description:
A roguelike action brawler from Klei where up to four players hunt corrupted beasts, master weapons, combine run-based power-ups, and upgrade gear between expeditions.

Players enter the Rotwood to fight corrupted beasts and push back a spreading blight. The game focuses more on repeated expeditions and combat progression than on cutscene-heavy storytelling. Progression comes through mastery, upgrades and deeper runs into increasingly dangerous zones. The world is defined by Klei's stylized presentation and strange creature designs.

record.title: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun
record.titleEn: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun
record.titleKu: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun
record.description:
A stealth-oriented real-time tactics game set in Edo-period Japan. Control a team of five specialists, combine their abilities, and infiltrate heavily guarded castles, camps, and towns.

A new Shogun unifies Japan, but rebellion and conspiracy still threaten the peace. Five specialists are tasked with eliminating targets, gathering intelligence and protecting the realm. Each party member brings unique skills and a distinct personality to the unfolding conflict. The story mixes political tension, stealth suspense and character-driven moments across the campaign.

record.title: Split Fiction
record.description: Split Fiction is a two-player cooperative action-adventure by Hazelight Studios. Writers Mio and Zoe become trapped in a simulation built from their contrasting science-fiction and fantasy stories, forcing them to cooperate through rapidly changing mechanics, platforming, action, and puzzle sequences. The Nintendo Switch 2 version supports cooperative play and Friend's Pass features.
